name: Roy’s Hotel & Convention Center
address: Corner RC1, Araneta Highway, Barangay Pahanocoy, Bacolod City, Philippines
summary: A southern Bacolod hotel with family rooms, penthouses, pools and spaces for larger gatherings.
description:
A southern Bacolod hotel with family rooms, penthouses, pools and spaces for larger gatherings.

Roy’s combines accommodation with a convention centre in Pahanocoy. Its published room range spans compact queen and twin rooms, family options, suites and penthouses, making it useful to compare for a couple, a family or a larger travelling group.

sections.title: Room choices
sections.body: Published options include 20-square-metre Deluxe Queen or Twin rooms, 25-square-metre Deluxe Family rooms and 35-square-metre suites. The Amigo Room has bunk-style accommodation for up to eight; the Attico Penthouse includes a jacuzzi. Confirm the bed layout and inclusions for your selected category.

sections.title: Dining and facilities
sections.body: Rozo Bistro, Aria Pool Lounge, Flex Fitness and the Play Pals children’s area are listed by the hotel. Pool access and event arrangements should be checked directly.

name: Circle Inn Hotel & Suites Bacolod
address: Lopez Jaena–Malaspina Streets, Villamonte, Bacolod City, Philippines
summary: A city hotel with an outdoor pool, an in-house restaurant and rooms for couples, families and groups.
description:
A city hotel with an outdoor pool, an in-house restaurant and rooms for couples, families and groups.

Circle Inn offers several room categories around its Villamonte property. It combines the essentials of a city stay with a pool and function facilities, away from the main Lacson hotel strip.

sections.title: Accommodation
sections.body: Superior rooms start at 20 square metres. Larger deluxe rooms, executive suites and family accommodation are also listed. Capacity varies considerably by room type, so specify your group size and preferred bed arrangement when enquiring.

sections.title: Dining and practical details
sections.body: The restaurant serves Filipino and American dishes alongside pasta and pizza. The hotel lists Wi-Fi, parking and a 24-hour front desk, as well as a ballroom and smaller function spaces.

name: Go Hotels Plus Bacolod
address: Lacson Street, adjacent to Robinsons Place Bacolod, Mandalagan, Bacolod City, Philippines
summary: A practical hotel beside Robinsons Bacolod, with queen and twin rooms and useful shared work spaces.
description:
A practical hotel beside Robinsons Bacolod, with queen and twin rooms and useful shared work spaces.

The updated Go Hotels Plus property has 105 rooms beside Robinsons Place Bacolod. Queen and twin options are designed for up to two guests, with published floor areas of approximately 16–22 square metres.

sections.title: Room essentials
sections.body: Rooms include air conditioning, a television, safe, Wi-Fi and a private bathroom with a hot shower. The hotel also advertises self check-in kiosks, a diner and shared work areas.

sections.title: Arriving by car
sections.body: Parking is offered on a first-come basis. Confirm availability, breakfast inclusions and the room’s guest limit before finalising your stay.

name: Magikland
address: Sitio Cabug, Barangay Guinhalaran, Silay City, Negros Occidental, Philippines
summary: A folklore-inspired outdoor theme park with a Ferris wheel, thrill rides and gentler family attractions.
description:
A folklore-inspired outdoor theme park with a Ferris wheel, thrill rides and gentler family attractions.

Magikland builds its theme around the local legend of Bakunawa. The park mixes high-energy attractions with family rides, so check the height restrictions against your children’s ages and heights before choosing a ticket.

sections.title: Rides and tickets
sections.body: Attractions include the Ferris wheel, Crazy Trail, Family Swinger, Happy Swing and a trackless train. Admission and ride passes are different products; review the current ticket page for what each includes.

sections.title: Plan your visit
sections.body: The September 2026 schedule lists Friday to Sunday openings, 1:00–8:00 pm. Special dates and weather can affect operations. Use the park’s current calendar before travelling to Silay.

name: Bernardino Jalandoni Museum
address: Rizal Street, Silay City, Negros Occidental, Philippines
summary: Silay’s distinctive Pink House offers a look inside an early 20th-century Negrense family home.
description:
Silay’s distinctive Pink House offers a look inside an early 20th-century Negrense family home.

The former home of Bernardino and Ysabel Jalandoni was completed in 1908. Its pink exterior makes it easy to recognise along Silay’s main street, while the preserved interiors and household objects help tell the story of a prosperous family’s everyday life.

sections.title: Planning a heritage day
sections.body: Pair this stop with other Silay heritage houses. Contact the museum before travelling for current opening times, admission and guided-visit arrangements; historic-house access may involve stairs.

name: Hofileña Ancestral House
address: Cinco de Noviembre Street, Silay City, Negros Occidental, Philippines
summary: A Silay heritage home known for its family history and collection of Philippine art.
description:
A Silay heritage home known for its family history and collection of Philippine art.

Built as the home of Manuel Severino Hofileña and his family, this ancestral house combines domestic history with an art collection. It is a smaller, more personal stop than a conventional museum and works well as part of a Silay heritage outing.

sections.title: Arrange a visit
sections.body: Ask ahead about access and tour arrangements. The house’s visiting schedule can depend on its caretakers, and it is worth allowing time for the stories behind the collection.

name: Museo De La Salle – Bacolod
address: University of St. La Salle, La Salle Avenue, Bacolod City, Philippines
summary: A university museum with collections that explore Negrense culture, heritage and local history.
description:
Museo De La Salle is the university museum on the University of St. La Salle campus in Bacolod. Its collections offer a cultural stop in the La Salle Avenue area.

Arrange your visit through the museum rather than assuming unrestricted walk-in access to the campus. Ask about the current exhibitions, visitor requirements and arrangements for school or other groups.

sections.title: Collections and textiles
sections.body: The museum’s permanent collections include religious art, antique household objects and works connected to Negrense family histories. The JGM Textile Arts Center holds handmade indigenous textiles from more than 70 countries, donated in memory of Jose Garcia Montelibano.

sections.title: Arrange a visit
sections.body: Contact museum@usls.edu.ph or call the university and ask for extension 186. Confirm the museum schedule, campus entry requirements, admission and any guided-visit options before setting out.

name: Balay ni Tana Dicang
address: Rizal Street, Talisay City, Negros Occidental, Philippines
summary: A preserved Talisay ancestral house with strong links to Negros’ social and political history.
description:
A preserved Talisay ancestral house with strong links to Negros’ social and political history.

Built in 1872, Balay ni Tana Dicang is a bahay-na-bato associated with Efigenia Lizares, known as Tana Dicang. Its heritage significance was recognised with a National Historical Commission marker in 2023.

sections.title: Visiting the house
sections.body: Confirm the current visiting schedule and admission before setting out. This is a heritage-home experience in Talisay; leave time for a guided explanation of the family and the building.

name: Panaad Park & Sports Complex
address: Barangay Mansilingan, Bacolod City, Negros Occidental, Philippines
summary: A leafy provincial park and sports complex best known as the home of the Panaad Festival.
description:
A leafy provincial park and sports complex best known as the home of the Panaad Festival.

Panaad brings sports facilities, eucalyptus-lined grounds and pavilions representing Negros Occidental’s local government areas together in southern Bacolod. The setting is especially lively during the provincial festival; activity levels are different on an ordinary day.

sections.title: Access and events
sections.body: Check the provincial event calendar and gate notices before travelling. Festival pavilions and sports facilities do not necessarily keep the same public-access schedule outside organised events.

name: SM City Bacolod
address: Rizal Street, Reclamation Area, Bacolod City, Philippines
summary: A major shopping, dining and entertainment stop in Bacolod’s reclamation area.
description:
A major shopping, dining and entertainment stop in Bacolod’s reclamation area.

SM City Bacolod combines retail, food choices and cinema facilities near the downtown district. Its official directory is useful for finding a particular store, checking which wing it occupies and planning a visit around current events.

sections.title: Plan a stop
sections.body: Use the mall’s live directory for individual shop information and special holiday schedules. The mall is also convenient for guests staying at the connected Park Inn by Radisson.

name: Ayala Malls Capitol Central
address: Gatuslao Street, Capitol Central, Bacolod City, Philippines
summary: Shopping and dining beside Bacolod’s Capitol district, close to the lagoon and central heritage stops.
description:
Shopping and dining beside Bacolod’s Capitol district, close to the lagoon and central heritage stops.

The mall forms part of the Capitol Central estate surrounding the provincial government complex. It is a practical place for a meal or an indoor break when spending time around the Capitol Park area.

sections.title: Combine it with a walk
sections.body: The surrounding district includes the provincial capitol, lagoon and cultural stops. Check the mall’s own announcements for store openings, events and holiday hours.

name: Robinsons Bacolod
address: Lacson Street, Mandalagan, Bacolod City, Philippines
summary: A long-established Mandalagan mall for shopping, meals, groceries and cinema outings.
description:
A long-established Mandalagan mall for shopping, meals, groceries and cinema outings.

Robinsons Bacolod has three levels of shops, restaurants, entertainment and services. It anchors the northern Lacson commercial area and sits beside Go Hotels Plus Bacolod.

sections.title: Finding a store
sections.body: Check the official virtual directory for the current tenant list and contact details. Individual shops and holiday periods may follow different schedules.

name: Bacolod Government Center
address: Bacolod City Government Center, Circumferential Road, Bacolod City, Philippines
summary: Bacolod’s civic landmark and public grounds, with redevelopment work scheduled through 2026.
description:
Bacolod’s civic landmark and public grounds, with redevelopment work scheduled through 2026.

The Government Center is a prominent city landmark. Its surrounding public space is being upgraded with landscaping, lighting and water features under a TIEZA-funded redevelopment project.

sections.title: Current access notice
sections.body: A June 2026 city update targeted completion of the redevelopment for September or October 2026. Completion has not been confirmed in this listing. Follow barriers and local notices, and check access before planning an outing around the grounds.

name: Nena’s Rose Inasal · Manokan Country
address: Temporary Manokan Country, SM City Bacolod transport hub area, Bacolod City, Philippines
summary: A long-running local chicken inasal stop at Manokan Country’s temporary SM-side location.
description:
A long-running local chicken inasal stop at Manokan Country’s temporary SM-side location.

Nena’s Rose is one of the familiar names associated with Bacolod’s chicken inasal tradition. This listing refers to the Manokan Country outlet, now at the temporary location while the original complex is redeveloped.

sections.title: Find the current location
sections.body: Use the outlet’s latest directions before setting out. Older maps and articles may still point to the former Manokan Country stalls.

name: Aida’s Chicken · Manokan Country
address: Temporary Manokan Country, SM City Bacolod transport hub area, Bacolod City, Philippines
summary: A well-known Manokan Country name for Bacolod-style grilled chicken and a casual inasal meal.
description:
A well-known Manokan Country name for Bacolod-style grilled chicken and a casual inasal meal.

Aida’s has a Bacolod outlet at Manokan Country as well as a separately listed Manila branch. This page covers Bacolod: a useful stop for visitors exploring the city’s grilled-chicken food culture.

sections.title: Location during redevelopment
sections.body: Manokan Country vendors have been using a temporary SM-side location while the original site is redeveloped. Confirm Aida’s current directions directly; avoid relying on older location pins.
